content: Antteya'chone candusian'cho
Ja'ño que'i tevaemba iñajampaña'chone gi condaseye tson'jen. Tsandie pushembe'yi can'jensi ñotssi tsu.
Tsa'ma pushembe'yi pushesui'ccu egae tsinconsa'ne bove ñotssi tsu poiyi'cco tsandie pushepa tisu pushei'ccu canseye; poiyi'cco pushesu'qque tsa'ndupa tisu tsa'ndui'ccu canseye.
Tsa'ndu tsu tise pushenga se'pimbe'yi tisu ai'voma afeya'cho. Pushe'qque tisu ai'voma tise tsa'ndunga se'pimbe'yi afeya'cho.
Nane pushe tsu tisu ai'voma mandambi. Tsa'ma tise tsa'nduja tise na'su tsu. Toya'caen tsa'ndu tisu ai'voma mandambisi tise pushe tsu tise na'su.

Tisunga antte'choma se'picco'fajama. Nane fae'ngae in'jamba Chigama iñajañeñi re'riccone fae'ngae cansembe'yi cañe tsu ñotssi. Tsa'ma tsa'caen can'jenccapa ccase tsu fae'ngae canseya'cho. In'jamba'qque cocoya na'su, Satana, que'ima qqueñasi tsa'caen can'jeñe oshambipa egae tsinconsa'ne.
Ñajan tsa'caen mandambipa aqquia antte'choma su:
Bove ñotssi tsu poiyi'cco ña'caen tisuyi can'jeñe. Tsa'ma in'jan gi poiyi'cco a'i tsu ccaninga'fa. Chigaja fae a'inga afeqquia'caen cca'indeccunga afembisi ccaningae tsu canse'fa.
Toya anttembi'chondeccunga, tsandupajen'chondeccunga'qque gi conda bove ñotssi tsu tise'panejan ja'ño tisuyi canse'faye. Tsa'caen gi ñajan canse.
Tsa'ma tsa'caen cansepa tisuma coiraye oshambi'ta casaraya'cho. Nane casaraye tsu bove ñotssi egae tsincoñe panshaen in'jansa'ne.
Tayo casara'chondeccuma gi qquen manda: (Nane ñajan mandambisi Na'su Cristo tsu qquen manda.) Pushesu tsu tise tsa'nduma catimbe'yi canseya'cho.
Tsa'ma cati'ta tsu tisuyi canseya'cho. Tsambi'ta ccase tsu tisu tsa'ndungayi jiya'cho. Toya'caen tsandie'qque tisu pushema catimbe'yi tsu canseya'cho.

Cca'indeccunga gi su: (Na'su Cristo vama mandambisi ña injama'chone gi conda.) Majan pushesu Cristove in'jambi'choa Cristove in'jan'cho tsandiema tsa'ndupa chi'gambi'ninda tsa tsandie tise pushema catimbe'yi canseya'cho.
Toya'caen tsandie Cristove in'jambi'choa Cristove in'jan'cho pushesuma pushepa chi'gambi'ninda tsa pushesu tsu tsa'nduma catimbe'yi tisei'ccu canseya'cho.

Tsa'ndu toya Cristove in'jambi'a'qque tise pushe Cristove in'jansi tsa'ndu'qque tsu Chiga ñotssiama fae'ngae isuya. Toya'caen pushe toya Cristove in'jambi'a'qque tise tsa'ndu Cristove in'jansi Chiga ñotssiama tsu tisei'ccu fae'ngae isuya. Toya'caen caticco'fa'choecan'da tise'pa dushundeccu'qque tsu qque'faye'can. Tsa'ma fae'ngae canse'fasi tsu dushundeccu'qque Chiga ñotssiama isu'faya.

Can'jeñe se'pimbisi tsu tsa'can. Tsa'ma tsa Cristove in'jambi'choa tsangae tise casara'choma catiye in'jan'ninda tisema se'pijama. Tsa'caen catipa jasi Cristove in'jan'cho tsu tise'ye somboqquia'caen ccusha. Nane Chigaja ingima ttu'se opatsse canse'faye.

Tsa'cansi Cristove in'jan'cho pushesu, ¿ma'caen qui Chiga tsoña'choma atesuya? Que tsa'nduma catimbisi Chiga in'jan'da que tsa'nduma'qque tsu ccushaeña. Toya'caen Cristove in'jan'cho tsandie, que'qque atesumbi qui Chiga ma'caen tsoña'choma. Que pushema catimbisi Chiga in'jan'da que pushema'qque tsu ccushaeña.

Toya'caen ñotsse in'jan'faja: Poiyi'cco tsu Na'su Chiga antteqquia'caen canse'faya'cho. Chiga tsa'caen que'ima antte'ninda qui Chiganga ttuseyeqquia'caen canse'faya'cho. Tsa'caen gi poiyi'cco Cristove in'jamba bo'fa'chondeccunga candusian'jen.
¿Majan que'i'su Chiga que'ima ttu'sesi chhiyitevaen'choja? Ñoña'fajama ttonoma chhiyi'choma a'tuye. Toya'caen majan Chiga que'ima ttu'sesi chhiyitevaembi'choaja que ttonoma chhiyitevaenjama.
Nane chhiyitevaen'choja barembi. Toya'caen chhiyitevaembi'choa'qque barembi. Tsa'ma Chigaja in'jan tise aindeccuja Tise manda'choma pañamba tsa'caen canse'faye.
Poiyi'cco tsu Chiganga ttuseyeqquia'caen can'jen'faya'cho.
Chiga que'ima ttu'sesi patrónpa'ta somboye panshaen in'jan'fajama. Tsa'ma patrón quema somboeñe qquen su'ninda cuintsu sombo'faja.
Nane majanjan Chiganga ttu'seyepa patrónpa'ta Na'su Chigambe patrón mechoa a'ive tsu da. Toya'caen majanjan Chiganga ttu'seyepa patrón mechosi ñoa'me Chiga tsu tise patrónme da.
Tsain'bitsse afepoenqquia'caen Chigaja Jesús anjampai'ccu que'ima chava. Tsa'cansi antte'fajama a'i que'i patrónme dapa mandaqquia'caen va ande'su in'jan'cho que'ima mandasa'ne.
Tsa'cansi faengasundeccu, poiyi'cco tsu Chiganga ttuseyepa can'jenqquia'caen can'jen'faya'cho. Ja'ño Chigaja que'i'ccu can'jemba fuite'je.
Toya casarambindeqquia'ne Na'su Chiga mandambisi gi asi'ttaemba ña in'jan'choma condaye tson'jen. Chiga ñama ttu'sepa fuitesi qui dyombi'tsse ña su'choma pañañe osha'fa.
Cristove in'jan'chondeccu ja'ño vana'jensi gi asi'ttaen bove ñotssi tsu a'ija casarambe'yi tisuyi canse'faye.
Tsa'ma ¿queta ti qui pushepa? Que pushema catijama tisuyi can'jeñe. ¿Toya ti qui pushembi? Pushesuve tta'ttajama.

Tsa'ma pusheve pushe'ta qui egae tsincon'fambi. Toya'caen pushesu'qque tsa'ndu'ta egae tsincombi. Tsa'ma poiyi'cco majan tsa'caen casara'ta vani canseite vanaqque'suma ti'tsse tsu vana'faya. Tsama gi osha'ta que'i'ye joqquitssiaña.
Faengasundeccu, ñoa'me gi su, re'ricco tsu shaca ingima vanaeña'cho. Ja'ño tsu pushe'pandeqquia pushe mechoa'caen canse'faya'cho.
Ina'jen'chondeccu tsu ñombi'yembiqquia'caen canse'faya'cho. Avuja'chondeccu avujatssimbiqquia'caen canse'faya'cho. Chavasundeccuja jongoesuma chavapa tisumbembima'caen an'bian'faya'cho.
Majan a'i va andeni'su jincho'choi'ccu jinchopa panshaen tsa'caen jinchombiqquia'caen canse'faya'cho. Ñoa'me tsu va andeni jincho'choja pasaya.

In'jan gi ñajan cuintsu que'ija osha'chove panshaen in'jambe'yi opatsse canse'faye. Majan tsandie pusheve mechoaja Na'su Cristo jincho'chone tsu in'jamba asi'ttaen: “¿Ma'caen gi tsoña Na'su Cristo avujatssiye?”
Tsa'ma majan tsandie pushepa'ta tsu va andeni'su jincho'choma in'jamba asi'ttaen: “¿Ma'caen gi tsoña tisu pushe avujatssiye?”

Poiningae tsu in'jan. Toya'caen pushesu tsa'ndu mechoa, toya tsandiema atesumbi'choa'qque Na'su Cristo in'jan'chove tsu in'jan'fa ma'caen tisupa ai'voi'ccu ñotsse cansepa tisupa injama'choi'ccu Chigaveyi in'jaña'chove canseye. Tsa'ma majan pushesu tsa'ndupa va ande'su in'jan'chove in'jamba asi'ttaen: “¿Ma'caen gi tsoña tisu tsa'ndu avujatssiye?”

Vama gi conda que'i ti'tsse atesu'faye. Nane se'pimbi gi. Tsa'ma fuiteye gi in'jan cuintsu que'i ñotsse atesupa canse'faye. Tsa'caen atesupa poi a'ta Na'su Cristoveyi in'jamba tisema pañamba canse'faye.

Majan pushesumbe yaya qquen tsu in'jan: “Ña onque'nge tayo coemba bo'tssingae tsa'ndumbeyi cansesi egae tsinconsa'ne bove ñotssi tsu tsandienga antteye.” Qquen in'jan'da tsu antteya'cho. Tsa'caen antte'ta egae tsincombi tsu.

Tsa'ma faesu pushesumbe yaya tisu injama'cho ta'etssipa tisu onque'ngema antteye se'pi'ta tsa'qque ñotssi tsu. Nane tsa'caen in'jamba ni ccaningae asi'ttaembi'ta tisu onque'ngema anttembe'yi coiraye ñotssi tsu.
Tsa'cansi majan tisu onque'ngema antte'ta ñotsse tsu tson. Toya'caen majan tisema anttembi'a'qque bove ñotsse tsu tson.

Majan pushesu tsandu'pa tisu tsa'ndu canseite tisei'ccu canseya'cho. Tsa'caen tsu manda'choja manda. Tsa'ma tsa'ndu pasi pushesuja majame in'jan'da faesuma tsa'nduye ñotssi Na'su Cristove in'jan'choma.
Tsa'ma ccase tsa'caen tsa'ndumbe canse'ta ti'tsse avujatssiya tsu qquen gi in'jan. Chiga Qquendya'pa ñama'qque in'jaen qquen in'jamba gi tsa'caen conda.
